name: Omokage
source:
Main character receives an invitation from his classmate girl to investigate disappearance of a Taiwanese at a western mansion. They are greeted by the old maid of the house, but then get trapped inside the mansion. And terrible events start to happen...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受一位女同学邀请，前往一座西式洋馆调查一名中国台湾人的失踪事件。宅邸里的老女仆接待了他们，可两人随后被困在了洋馆之中。可怕的事件也由此接连发生…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
